senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Abandoning, who leaves or abandons.
m. (-कः)
1 Time.
2 A child.
3 The slough of a snake.
E.
हा to quit, or abandon, कन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A cat.
2 A pole-cat.
3 A bed, a cot.
4 A leech.
E.
हा to quit, affix ण्वुल्; radical initial doubled.

mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्)
Leaving, quitting, foregoing.
E.
हा to quit, शतृ aff.

f. (-र्था)
The use of a word in a sense different from its ordinary one.
E.
जहत्, and स्वार्थ own meaning.

f. (-हा)
A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī; also कदम्बपुष्पी, &c.
E.
हा to abandon ड, affixes and टाप्; shedding its leaves in spring.

m. (-कः)
The period of the total destruction of the world.
E.
हा to abandon, शानच् affix, and कन् added; also इ being substituted for the vowel of reduplication, जिहानक as it is sometimes read.

m. (-ह्नुः)
1 The name of a king or saint, son of KURU: see the next.
2 A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
हा to abandon, (the world for devotion,) नु Uṇādi aff.

f. (-या)
The Ganges.
E.
जह्नु, and तनया the daughter; the river in its course disturbed the devotions of the saint JAHNU, upon which he drank up its waters; having released them at the intercession of BHAGĪRATHA, he is thus considered as the parent of the stream: see जाह्नवी; also जह्नुसुता, &c.

f. (-वी)
GAṄGĀ or the Ganges personified.
E.
जह्नु a saint, अण् affix of descent, fem. affix ङीष्, the daughter of JAHNU: see जह्नुतनया.
